description: Topic index with source-derived notes and representative runnable examples.

topics.example_code:
# math square root
    print("Square root of 81: ", math.sqrt(81))

    # datetime formatted timestamp
    print("Current ISO date:  ", datetime.date.today().isoformat())

    # collections Counter frequency
    print("Counter top:       ", Counter(["a", "b", "a"]).most_common(1))

    # collections namedtuple
    Point = namedtuple("Point", ["x", "y"])
    p = Point(5, 10)
    print(f"Point: x={p.x}, y={p.y}")

    # itertools combinations
    print("Combinations:      ", list(itertools.combinations([1, 2, 3], 2)))
